eyebrow: What I found from the outside
headline: Missed 2am calls could be costing you about $11,340 a month.
lede: Your site leads with a 24/7 line and a 60-minute arrival, and that promise only holds when someone picks up. Overnight, the person answering is often the one running equipment on another loss, and a homeowner standing in water does not leave a voicemail.

assumption_line: My estimates, from your site and typical restoration economics. You know your real call volume. Tell me where I'm off.
fix_copy: An AI voice agent answers every call live, takes the address, water source and carrier, dispatches your on-call tech and texts the homeowner an arrival window. A night dispatcher or answering service doing that job runs $2,500 to $4,000 a month.
